interface.name: xdg_wm_base
interface.description: This interface is implemented by servers that provide desktop-style user interfaces. It allows clients to associate a xdg_surface with a basic window.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this xdg_wm_base object.

request.name: create_positioner
request.description: Create a positioner object. A positioner object is used to position surfaces relative to some parent surface. See the interface description and xdg_surface.get_popup for details.

request.name: get_xdg_surface

description.summary: create a shell surface from a surface

request.description: This creates an xdg_surface for the given surface. While xdg_surface is managed by the compositor, to ensure that xdg_surface only represents one surface to the client, it is forbidden to create more than one xdg_surface for any given wl_surface.

request.name: pong
request.description: A client must respond to a ping event with a pong request or the client may be deemed unresponsive.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: serial number of the ping event

event.name: ping
event.description: The ping event asks the client if it's still alive. The client is supposed to respond with a pong request.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: serial number of the ping event

interface.name: xdg_positioner
interface.description: The xdg_positioner provides a collection of rules for the placement of a child surface relative to a parent surface. Rules can be defined to ensure the child surface remains within the visible area's borders, and to specify how the child surface changes its position, either sliding along an axis, or flipping around a rectangle. These positioner-created rules are constrained by the requirement that a child surface must intersect with or be at least partially visible within its parent surface at all times.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Notify the compositor that the xdg_positioner will no longer be used.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: set the size of the to-be-positioned surface

request.description: Set the size of the surface that is to be positioned.

request.name: set_anchor_rect

description.summary: set the anchor rectangle within the parent surface

request.description: Specify the anchor rectangle within the parent surface that the child surface will be placed relative to. The rectangle is relative to the upper-left corner of the parent surface.

request.name: set_anchor
request.description: Defines a set of edges for the anchor rectangle. These are used to derive an anchor point that the child surface will be positioned relative to. If no orthogonal edges are specified (e.g. 'top' and 'left'), then the anchor point will be at the specified offset; otherwise, the anchor point will be at the intersection of the specified edges.

request.name: set_gravity
request.description: Defines in what direction a surface should be positioned, relative to the anchor point of the anchor rectangle. If no orthogonal gravity is specified (e.g. 'bottom' and 'left'), then the child surface will be moved towards the specified gravity; otherwise, the child surface will be moved towards the specified gravities.

request.name: set_constraint_adjustment

description.summary: set the adjustment to be done when constrained

request.description: Specify how the window should be positioned if the originally intended position caused the surface to be constrained, meaning at least partially outside positioning boundaries set by the compositor. The adjustment is set by constructing a bitmask describing the adjustment to be made when the surface is constrained on that axis.

request.name: set_offset
request.description: Specify the surface position offset relative to the position of the anchor on the anchor rectangle.

request.name: set_reactive
request.description: When set reactive, the surface is reconstrained if the conditions used for constraining changed, e.g. the parent window moved.

request.name: set_parent_size

description.summary: set the parent window geometry the surface is positioned relative to

request.description: Set the parent window geometry the surface is positioned relative to. The parent geometry is reported in the parent surface coordinate system.

request.name: set_parent_configure

description.summary: set parent configure this is a response to

request.description: Set the serial of an xdg_surface.configure event this positioner will be used in response to. The compositor may use this information together with set_parent_size to determine what future state the popup should be reconstructed using.

interface.name: xdg_surface

description.summary: desktop user interface surface base interface

interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for implementations that provide a desktop-style user interface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the xdg_surface object. An xdg_surface must only be destroyed after its role object has been destroyed.

request.name: get_toplevel
request.description: This creates an xdg_toplevel object for the given xdg_surface and gives the associated wl_surface the xdg_toplevel role.

request.name: get_popup
request.description: This creates an xdg_popup object for the given xdg_surface and gives the associated wl_surface the xdg_popup role.

request.name: set_window_geometry
request.description: The window geometry of a surface is its "visible bounds" from the user's perspective. Client-side decorations often have invisible portions where the surface is not drawn, e.g. drop-shadows. The window geometry is set by the compositor to tell the client that the visible area of the window has changed, and is needed for synchronizing window geometry with the frame. The client should respond by updating the content drawn to the surface, but the client is not required to consider the window geometry in its drawing pipeline.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client commits the surface in response to the configure event, then the client must make an ack_configure request sometime before the commit request, passing along the serial of the configure event.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: the serial from the configure event

event.name: configure
event.description: The configure event marks the end of a configure sequence. A configure sequence is a set of one or more events configuring the state of the xdg_surface, including the final xdg_surface.configure event.

interface.name: xdg_toplevel
interface.description: This interface defines an xdg_surface role which allows a surface to, among other things, set window-like properties such as maximize, fullscreen, and minimize, set application-specific metadata like title and id, and well as trigger user interactive operations such as interactive resize and move.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request destroys the role surface and unmaps the surface.

request.name: set_parent

description.summary: set the parent of this surface

request.description: Set the "parent" of this surface. This window should be stacked above a parent. The parent surface must be mapped as a toplevel surface.

request.name: set_title
request.description: Set a short title for the surface.

request.name: set_app_id
request.description: Set an application identifier for the surface.

request.name: show_window_menu
request.description: Clients implementing client-side decorations might want to show a context menu when right-clicking on the decorations, for instance through an xdg_popup with xdg_positioner.

request.name: move
request.description: Start an interactive, user-driven move of the surface.

request.name: resize
request.description: Start a user-driven, interactive resize of the surface.

request.name: set_max_size
request.description: Set a maximum size for the window.

request.name: set_min_size
request.description: Set a minimum size for the window.

request.name: set_maximized
request.description: Maximize the surface.

request.name: unset_maximized
request.description: Unmaximize the surface.

request.name: set_fullscreen

description.summary: set the window as fullscreen on an output

request.description: Make the surface fullscreen on an output.

request.name: unset_fullscreen
request.description: Make the surface no longer fullscreen.

request.name: set_minimized
request.description: Request that the compositor minimize your surface. There is no way to know if the surface is currently minimized, nor is there any way to unminimize the surface from within the client. The compositor is free to ignore this request.

event.name: configure
event.description: This configure event asks the client to resize its toplevel surface or to change its state. The configured state should not be applied immediately. See xdg_surface.configure for details.

event.name: close
event.description: The close event is sent by the compositor when the user wants the surface to be closed. This should be equivalent to the user clicking the close button in client-side decorations, if your application has any.

interface.name: xdg_popup
interface.description: A popup surface is a short-lived, temporary surface. It can be used to implement for example menus, popovers, tooltips and other similar user interface concepts.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This destroys the popup. Explicitly destroying the xdg_popup object will also dismiss the popup, and unmap the surface.

request.name: grab

description.summary: make the popup take an explicit grab

request.description: This request makes the created popup take an explicit grab on the seat that was used to create the popup. This will be done when the user's finger is lifted.

request.name: reposition
request.description: Reposition an already-mapped popup. The popup will be given a new position, specified by the positioner object.

event.name: configure
event.description: This event asks the popup surface to configure itself given the configuration. The configured state should not be applied immediately. See xdg_surface.configure for details.

arg.name: x
arg.summary: x position relative to parent surface

arg.name: y
arg.summary: y position relative to parent surface

event.name: popup_done
event.description: The popup_done event is sent out when the popup is dismissed by the compositor. The client should destroy the xdg_popup object at this point.

event.name: repositioned
event.description: The repositioned event is sent as part of a popup configuration sequence, together with xdg_popup.configure and optionally xdg_surface.configure. The repositioned event specifies where the popup should be positioned relative to the new position of the parent surface.
